inputIndexPolicy: candidateIndex refers to zero-based original112-row native-crossing-profile-candidates input. Do not confuse with111 spatial coverage group indices.
method: Visually inspected all24 native-source plan/terrain panels, then enlarged key suspected true-deck cases.
Compared original City RoadPaved, Bridges and StreetCentreline footprints; computed .5m native DSM/DTM point samples inside pavement.
Read5 bounded City line queries to distinguish mapped Railway structures from road decks.
Alternative windows are extraction aids only; final geometry must retain actual source road footprints and exclude unrelated lower roads.
limits: No model or height was altered. Actual upper-deck cases still require safe source-footprint extraction, segmented fitting where needed and approach/topology QA.
No coherent paved depression means these native inputs do not establish a required lift. It is not a certified construction-type or as-built statement.
Source roadway/river geometry vintages differ; 2015 DSM may predate later lane widening.
Cases outside the finite original coverage screen were not added.
coarseTerrainFollowupNote: A native DSM/native DTM match does not prove that the inherited 10 m model terrain follows a small road correctly. Five earlier no-lift candidates were separately checked against the coarse model source; two modest grade dips were identified and handed to implementation.
